# Servixa

Servixa is a software development and digital solutions company providing custom software, websites, mobile applications, AI automation, cloud and DevOps, cybersecurity, UI/UX, enterprise platforms, data analytics, IT staff augmentation and global IT support.

## Core services

- Custom software development
- Web development and web applications
- Mobile app development for Android, iOS and cross-platform products
- Generative AI, intelligent assistants and workflow automation
- Cloud architecture, migrations and DevOps
- Cybersecurity and secure architecture
- UI/UX and product design
- Data analytics and business intelligence
- Microsoft Power Platform
- Dynamics 365 ERP and CRM
- IT staff augmentation
- Global field IT support

## Technology capabilities

Servixa works with technologies including Flutter, React, Next.js, TypeScript, Node.js, Python, .NET, GraphQL, PostgreSQL, Supabase, Docker, Kubernetes, AWS and Azure.
